campusStyle: Low, earthy California-ranch / Craftsman style: tan and beige stucco walls, brown asphalt-shingle gable roofs with wide eaves and exposed rafter tails, and dark brown window frames. Newer buildings add stacked gray-brown stone pillars, heavy-timber gabled entrances and wood-slat screens. Older ones use dark brick columns and black metal railings. Large oaks, lawns, and low tan block walls with rail fences along the roads.
